entities.name: Mohammad Ebrahim Hemmat
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mohammad Ebrahim Hemmat was an Iranian military leader and teacher. He was one of the highest-ranking officers of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps during the Iran-Iraq War. In 1982, he spent a few months fighting against Israel during the 1982 Lebanon War. He then returned to Iran and held commanding roles in several missions during the Iran-Iraq War. He was killed in action in March 1984 in Operation Kheibar.
